r. 1st cl. (म्रक्षति)
1 To accumulate.
2 To smear, to anoint.
10th cl. (म्रक्षयति)
1 To mix.
2 To speak incorrectly.

m. (-क्षः)
Slyness, hypocrisy, concealment of one's vices or defects.
E.
म्रक्ष to anoint, aff. अच्.

Smearing the body with fragrant oils or unguents.
E.
म्रक्ष to smear or anoint, ल्युट् aff.

r. 1st cl. (म्रचति)
To go, to move.

r. 1st cl. (म्रदते)
1 To grind, to pound, to reduce to powder or dust.
2 To tread or trample on.

m. (-मा)
Softness.
E.
मृद् soft, and इमनिच् aff.

Kind.
E.
म्रदिमन्, and अन्वित endowed with.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very soft, exceedingly soft, softest.
E.
मृदु soft, and इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative, ऋ changed to र.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Softer, milder.
E.
मृदु soft, and इयसुन् aff. of the comparative, and the vowel changed to the semivowel.
